text_en: Now Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, “As the Lord the God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word. ”
text_cn: 基肋阿得提市贝出身的提市贝人厄里亚对阿哈布说：“我指着我所服侍的永生上主、以色列的天主起誓：这几年如果没有我的命令，天决不降露或落雨！”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to him, saying,
text_cn: 有上主的话传于厄里亚说：

text_en: “Go from here and turn eastward, and hide yourself by the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
text_cn: “你离开这里，转向东方，隐居在约但河东的革黎特小河旁。

text_en: You shall drink from the wadi, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there. ”
text_cn: 你要喝那小河里的水，我已经吩咐乌鸦在那里供给你食物。”

text_en: So he went and did according to the word of the Lord ; he went and lived by the Wadi Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
text_cn: 厄里亚就依照上主的话去做，去住在约但河东的革黎特小河旁。

text_en: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the wadi.
text_cn: 乌鸦早晨给他送饼和肉来，晚上也给他送饼和肉来；渴了，就喝那小河里的水。

text_en: But after a while the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
text_cn: 不几天以后，那地方没有落雨，小河也干涸了。

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
text_cn: 有上主的话传于厄里亚说：

text_en: “Go now to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and live there; for I have commanded a widow there to feed you. ”
text_cn: “你起身往漆冬匝尔法特去，住在那里；我已吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。”

text_en: So he set out and went to Zarephath. When he came to the gate of the town, a widow was there gathering sticks; he called to her and said, “Bring me a little water in a vessel, so that I may drink. ”
text_cn: 他就起身往匝尔法特去了，来到城门时，看见一个寡妇在那里拾木柴。厄里亚唤她说：“请你用器皿取点水来给我喝！”

text_en: As she was going to bring it, he called to her and said, “Bring me a morsel of bread in your hand. ”
text_cn: 她正要去取水的时候，厄里亚又叫住她说：“请你也顺便给我拿点饼来！”

text_en: But she said, “As the Lord your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jug; I am now gathering a couple of sticks, so that I may go home and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it, and die. ”
text_cn: 那寡妇说：“我指着永生上主你的天主起誓：我没有饼，缸里只有一把面，罐里还有一点油。你看，我正要拾两根木柴，回去为我和我的儿子做点东西，吃了等死。”

text_en: Elijah said to her, “Do not be afraid; go and do as you have said; but first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterwards make something for yourself and your son.
text_cn: 厄里亚对她说：“你不用害怕，尽管照你所说的去做；只是先为我做一个小饼，给我拿来！然后，再为你和你的儿子做，

text_en: For thus says the Lord the God of Israel: The jar of meal will not be emptied and the jug of oil will not fail until the day that the Lord sends rain on the earth. ”
text_cn: 因为上主以色列的天主这样说：直到上主使雨落在这地上的那一天，缸里的面，决不会用完；罐里的油，也决不会缺少。”

text_en: She went and did as Elijah said, so that she as well as he and her household ate for many days.
text_cn: 那个寡妇就照厄里亚的话去做了；她和厄里亚并她的孩子吃了许多日子；

text_en: The jar of meal was not emptied, neither did the jug of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by Elijah.
text_cn: 缸里的面，果然没有用完，罐里的油，也没有减少，正如上主藉厄里亚所说的话。

text_en: After this the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became ill; his illness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
text_cn: 这事以后，那妇人，即那家的主母的儿子病了，病得很重，就断了气。

text_en: She then said to Elijah, “What have you against me, O man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to remembrance, and to cause the death of my son! ”
text_cn: 妇人于是对厄里亚说：“天主的人，我与你有什么关系？你到我这里来，竟叫上主记起我的罪恶，杀死了我的儿子！”

text_en: But he said to her, “Give me your son. ” He took him from her bosom, carried him up into the upper chamber where he was lodging, and laid him on his own bed.
text_cn: 厄里亚对妇人说：“把你的儿子交给我！”于是厄里亚从她怀里接过孩子来，抱到他住的楼上，放在自己的床上，

text_en: He cried out to the Lord , “O Lord my God, have you brought calamity even upon the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son? ”
text_cn: 呼求上主说：“上主，我的天主！我寄居在这寡妇家中，难道你也忍心加害于她，杀死她的儿子吗？”

text_en: Then he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried out to the Lord , “O Lord my God, let this child’s life come into him again. ”
text_cn: 厄里亚三次伏在孩子身上，呼求上主说：“上主，我的天主，求你使这孩子的灵魂再回到他身上！”

text_en: The Lord listened to the voice of Elijah; the life of the child came into him again, and he revived.
text_cn: 上主听了厄里亚的呼求，孩子的灵魂又回到他身上，孩子就又活了。

text_en: Elijah took the child, brought him down from the upper chamber into the house, and gave him to his mother; then Elijah said, “See, your son is alive. ”
text_cn: 厄里亚将孩子从楼上抱下来，到房间内，把孩子交给他母亲说：“看，你儿子活了！”

text_en: So the woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is truth. ”
text_cn: 那妇人对厄里亚说：“现在我知道你是天主的人，上主藉你的口所说的话，确是真理。”
